title: A mod $p$ determinant criterion for Cohen--Lenstra convergence of random $p$-adic matrices with prescribed zero patterns
summary: We study the distribution of cokernels of Haar-random matrices over the $p$-adic integers with prescribed zero patterns, motivated by the Cohen--Lenstra heuristics. A central feature of our approach is that the asymptotic cokernel distribution is governed by the reductions modulo $p$ of these matrices, viewed as random matrices over the finite field $\mathbb{F}_p$.
